posts.text:
I got the Anker Prime 160W charger for my MacBook Pro to replace the gigantically huge and ugly (and white???) official Apple 140W charger

The Anker one is cool because it's tiny, is dark gray (fits the Apple black cable), has 3x fast charging USB-C ports so you can also charge your phone and another device with it at the same time

I love everything Anker makes so much

Not paid or sponsored btw just an absolutely excellent brand

Maybe Apple should acquire them?
posts.text_zh:
我给 MacBook Pro 买了 Anker Prime 160W 充电器，用来替换官方那个超级巨大又难看（而且还是白色的???）的 Apple 140W 充电器

Anker 这款很酷，因为体积很小，是深灰色（和 Apple 的黑色线很搭），还有 3 个快充 USB-C 口，所以还能同时给手机和另一台设备充电

我太爱 Anker 做的所有东西了

顺便说一下，不是付费也不是赞助，只是这个品牌真的非常出色

也许 Apple 该把他们收购了？

posts.text:
Making the most AI pilled company is the whole game:

1. make a second brain. one folder of markdown files on how you think, write and decide (obsidian)

2. talk to it. voice notes all day (wispr), and an agent files every fact, story and decision

3. make a company brain. customers, calls, numbers, pricing, playbooks, past decisions and why you made them

4. record every call and meeting (granola). the transcripts go straight into the brain

5. keep a facts file. true things about you and the company that agents are allowed to say. this kills made-up claims

6. keep a voice file. your 50 best posts, 20 you hate, and the words you never use

7. put all of it in git (github) so every change has a history

8. write one instruction file at the top (CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md). read these files before any task, never overwrite, always date

9. give agents memory across sessions so they stop starting from zero (claude-mem, mem0)

10. pipe every data source into one warehouse your agents can query (airbyte → clickhouse). ads, analytics, CRM, payments

11. feed it data nobody else has. it's the only part a competitor can't download

the skills

12. don't start from zero. install the good ones first (anthropics/skills, obra/superpowers, mattpocock/skills, addyosmani/agent-skills)

13. grab the marketing ones too (coreyhaines31/marketingskills, cody schneider's graphed skills for static ads and UGC, boringmarketing dot com skills)

14. map every workflow in the company and rank them by money made or saved

15. do each one once while talking out loud, and record it

16. have an agent turn the recording into a skill. when to use it, the steps, the checks, the mistakes to avoid

17. one skill per job. small and boring beats one giant prompt

18. connect your tools with MCPs so agents can act and not only advise (gmail, slack, stripe, linear, notion, posthog, supabase)

19. give agents a browser (browser-use, vercel agent-browser, claude in chrome)

20. give agents a computer of their own for the tools with no API (vercel agent-desktop, orgo)

21. give your best skills away in public. it's the new lead magnet

the agents

22. run an orchestrator that never turns off (grok bot, openclaw, hermes). it manages one agent per project, and each of those runs its own sub-agents

23. use coding agents for the building (claude code, codex, cursor, t3, antigravity)

24. wrap them in a harness so they plan, test and remember (ECC, superpowers)

25. manage the whole fleet in one place (paperclip). every agent gets a job, a budget and a log

26. put the skills on triggers (n8n, scheduled tasks). daily, weekly, on every new lead, on every cancellation

27. route your models (openrouter). the expensive one plans and checks (fable 5.2, gemini 4 carbon), the cheap ones do the volume

28. cut the token bill. shorter outputs, smaller tool results (caveman)

29. run a local model for the data that can't leave your machine (gemma 4)

30. track cost per job. if a job costs more than it earns, fix it or kill it

the factory

31. build the line. spec agent → builder agents in parallel (git worktrees) → test agent → reviewer agent → deploy (vercel, railway)

32. design goes through the same line (paper MCP), and a skill strips out anything that looks AI made (unslop)

33. every annoying task in the company becomes an internal tool by the end of the day

34. every customer request becomes a pull request before a human reads it (tstack for the PR workflow)

35. reviewer agents with a named bar. "would the best team in the world ship this?" reject until the answer is yes

36. keep 50 real cases with the right answer. rerun them every time a new model drops and switch to the winner

37. humans approve, own the outcome and talk to customers. that's the 10% you keep

the loop

38. every finished job writes back to the brain. what worked, what failed, what to stop doing

39. support tickets, analytics and social comments flow in every night

40. every friday an agent rewrites the playbooks from the week's results, and you approve the diff

41. every month, rank everything by profit per human hour. kill one thing and double one thing

the growth

42. research with agents before you spend a dollar (perplexity API, last30days skill)

43. outbound runs itself. find the leads, enrich, verify, send (apollo, million verifier, instantly, phantombuster)

44. send prospects finished work in place of a pitch

45. ads run on a loop. an agent writes the creative, publishes through the facebook ads API, kills the losers and scales the winners

46. agents make the creative too. images (nano banana), video (heygen, fal), voice (elevenlabs), music (lyria 3.5, suno)

47. turn every finished job into content. the story, the number, the prompt

48. every customer makes the brain smarter for the next one. that's your network effect

49. once it works, point it at a new niche. same agents, new context

The models are the same for everyone but your context is the only part that's yours.

Acquire as much of it as you can, as fast as you can.

Build loops like this.

This is the whole game, happy playing.
posts.text_zh:
打造一家最 AI pilled 的公司，就是整场游戏的全部：

1. 做一个第二大脑。用一个文件夹里的 markdown 文件，记下你如何思考、写作和做决策（obsidian）

2. 跟它说话。整天用语音笔记（wispr），再让一个 agent 把每条事实、故事和决策归档

3. 做一个公司大脑。客户、通话、数字、定价、playbook、过往决策以及为什么那样决定

4. 录下每一通通话和每一次会议（granola）。转录直接进入大脑

5. 维护一份 facts 文件。记录关于你和公司的、允许 agents 说出去的真实事项。这能杜绝瞎编的说法

6. 维护一份 voice 文件。你最好的 50 条帖子、你讨厌的 20 条，以及你从不使用的词

7. 把这一切放进 git（github），这样每次改动都有历史

8. 在最顶层写一份指令文件（CLAUDE.md 或 AGENTS.md）。任何任务开始前先读这些文件，永远不要覆盖，始终注明日期

9. 给 agents 跨会话的记忆，让它们别每次都从零开始（claude-mem, mem0）

10. 把所有数据源导入一个仓库，让你的 agents 可以查询（airbyte → clickhouse）。广告、分析、CRM、支付

11. 喂给它别人没有的数据。这是竞争对手唯一下载不走的部分

the skills

12. 不要从零开始。先装好那些优秀的 skills（anthropics/skills, obra/superpowers, mattpocock/skills, addyosmani/agent-skills）

13. 营销相关的也要拿上（coreyhaines31/marketingskills、cody schneider 做静态广告和 UGC 的 graphed skills、boringmarketing dot com 的 skills）

14. 把公司里的每条工作流都画出来，并按能赚到或省下的钱排序

15. 每条工作流亲自做一遍，一边大声讲出来，一边录下来

16. 让一个 agent 把录音变成 skill：什么时候用、步骤、检查项、要避开的错误

17. 一个岗位一个 skill。又小又无聊的，胜过一个巨型 prompt

18. 用 MCP 把工具接上，让 agents 不只是给建议，还能动手（gmail, slack, stripe, linear, notion, posthog, supabase）

19. 给 agents 一个浏览器（browser-use, vercel agent-browser, claude in chrome）

20. 给 agents 一台它们自己的电脑，用来对付没有 API 的工具（vercel agent-desktop, orgo）

21. 把你最好的 skills 公开发出去。这就是新的获客磁铁（lead magnet）

the agents

22. 跑一个永不关闭的编排器（grok bot, openclaw, hermes）。它为每个项目管一个 agent，而这些 agent 再跑自己的 sub-agents

23. 用 coding agents 来做开发（claude code, codex, cursor, t3, antigravity）

24. 给它们套上 harness，让它们会规划、测试和记忆（ECC, superpowers）

25. 在一个地方管理整支舰队（paperclip）。每个 agent 都有任务、预算和日志

26. 把 skills 挂到触发器上（n8n, scheduled tasks）。每天、每周、每有新线索、每次取消时触发

27. 路由你的模型（openrouter）。贵的模型负责规划和检查（fable 5.2, gemini 4 carbon），便宜的模型扛量

28. 砍 token 账单。输出更短，工具返回结果更小（caveman）

29. 对不能离开你机器的数据，跑本地模型（gemma 4）

30. 跟踪每个任务的成本。如果一个任务成本高于它带来的收益，就修好它，或者干掉它

the factory

31. 把流水线搭起来。spec agent → 并行的 builder agents（git worktrees）→ test agent → reviewer agent → 部署（vercel, railway）

32. 设计也走同一条流水线（paper MCP），再用一个 skill 去掉任何看起来像 AI 做的东西（unslop）

33. 公司里每一件烦人的任务，当天结束前都变成一个内部工具

34. 每个客户请求在人类读到之前，先变成一个 pull request（用 tstack 做 PR 工作流）

35. reviewer agents 要有明确的标准：「世界上最强的团队会发这个吗？」答案是 yes 之前就一直拒

36. 保留 50 个有正确答案的真实案例。每次有新模型发布就重跑一遍，然后切到赢家

37. 人类负责批准、对结果负责，以及和客户交谈。这就是你留下的那 10%

the loop

38. 每个完成的任务都写回大脑。什么有效、什么失败、什么该停掉

39. 支持工单、分析和社交评论每天晚上流入

40. 每周五，一个 agent 根据本周结果重写 playbook，你来批准 diff

41. 每个月按「每人力小时利润」给所有事情排序。砍掉一件，加倍一件

the growth

42. 花每一块钱之前，先用 agents 做研究（perplexity API, last30days skill）

43. 外呼自己跑。找线索、enrich、验证、发送（apollo, million verifier, instantly, phantombuster）

44. 给潜在客户的不是推销词，而是已经做完的作品

45. 广告按循环跑。一个 agent 写创意，通过 facebook ads API 发布，干掉失败者，放量赢家

46. 创意也由 agents 来做。图片（nano banana），视频（heygen, fal），语音（elevenlabs），音乐（lyria 3.5, suno）

47. 把每一个完成的任务变成内容。故事、数字、prompt

48. 每个客户都会让大脑对下一个客户更聪明。这就是你的网络效应

49. 一旦跑通，就指向一个新的细分领域。同样的 agents，新的上下文

模型对所有人都一样，但你的上下文是唯一属于你的部分。

尽量多、尽量快地获取它。

像这样去构建循环。

这就是整场游戏，玩得开心。
